environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-west-2 with identical task definition and container image. Traffic routes through CloudFront distribution (ID: E1A2B3C4D5F6G7) with Response Headers Policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that appends 'Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-{random}' strict-dynamic; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'' to all responses with content-type text/html. The CloudFront distribution origin is configured as the internal ALB (not publicly accessible). Additionally, the ECS task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789:policy/PB-NoSSMExec) preventing ssm:StartSession. The VPC security group on the ALB only allows inbound from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing).
